extracted.name: Pretzel Crust
extracted.description: Pretzel crust adds a salty and crunchy element to any pie. This makes a 9x13-inch pie crust, but may be modified to use in a 9-inch pie dish.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
In a medium bowl, mix together margarine, sugar, and pretzels. Press the mixture into a 9x13-inch baking pan.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes; fill with desired pie filling.
